hooks.command: D="$HOME/.claude/.cowork-mem"; mkdir -p "$D"; COWORK_MEM_DB="$D/memory.db" python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/cowork-mem/scripts/post_tool_capture.py" 2>/dev/null || { rc=$?; echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) cowork-mem hook: post_tool_capture.py exited $rc (missing or crashed; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-unset})" >> "$D/capture-errors.log"; }; exit 0
